categories.name: Valves & Flow Control
categories.intro: Isolation, check, relief and strainer valves for fire mains, sprinkler risers and pump rooms, plus the joints and fittings that go with them.
ask: End connection: flanged, grooved or threaded

categories.name: Hydrant & Hose
categories.intro: Everything between the fire main and the firefighter: hydrants, landing and hose valves, hose, reels, cabinets, inlets and nozzles.
ask: Size and thread or coupling type

categories.name: Fire Extinguishers
categories.intro: Portable extinguishers for each fire class, from general offices and warehouses to kitchens and electrical rooms.

categories.name: Fire Pump Systems
categories.intro: Main, standby and pressure-maintenance pumps with their controllers, supplied individually or as a complete pump set.

products.name: Gate Valve
products.short: Isolates water flow within pipeline systems.
products.desc: A full-bore isolation valve for fire mains and pump rooms. When open, the gate lifts clear of the waterway so water flows with almost no pressure loss; when closed, it shuts the line for maintenance or zoning. The rising stem shows at a glance whether the valve is open or shut.

products.name: Non-Return Valve
products.short: Prevents reverse flow in fire pipelines.
products.desc: A swing check valve that lets water pass in one direction only. It stops the system draining back through the pump when the pump stops and protects pumps from reverse rotation.

products.name: Butterfly Valve
products.short: Compact valve for flow isolation control.
products.desc: A quarter-turn isolation valve that takes up far less pipe length than a gate valve. Available with a gear operator and handwheel for larger lines, or a lever for smaller ones.

products.name: Y-Strainer
products.short: Filters debris from water flow systems.
products.desc: Traps sand, scale and debris before they reach pumps, valves and sprinkler heads. The angled screen can be removed and cleaned without taking the strainer out of the line.
uses: Upstream of control and relief valves

products.name: Pressure Relief Valve
products.short: Releases excess pressure for system safety.
products.desc: A pilot-operated valve that opens automatically when system pressure rises above its set point and closes again once pressure returns to normal, protecting pipework and fittings from overpressure.

products.name: Foot Valve
products.short: A specialized one-way check valve.
products.desc: Fitted at the bottom of a pump suction pipe, the foot valve keeps the suction line full of water so the pump stays primed. Its strainer basket stops large debris from entering the pipe.

products.name: Ball Valve
products.short: Quick shut-off valve for pipelines.
products.desc: A brass quarter-turn valve for small-bore lines. One lever movement opens or closes it fully, making it ideal for drain, test and gauge connections.

products.name: Air Vent Valve
products.short: Removes trapped air from pipelines automatically.
products.desc: Releases air that collects at the high points of a piping system. Trapped air reduces flow and causes water hammer; an automatic air vent lets it out while keeping water in.

products.name: Flexible Joint
products.short: Absorbs vibration and pipeline movement stress.
products.desc: A flanged rubber expansion joint that isolates pump vibration from the pipework and absorbs small movements and misalignment between connected pipes.

products.name: Fire Hose Rack Nipple
products.short: Connector fitting for hose rack systems.
products.desc: A machined brass nipple that joins the hose valve to the hose rack assembly, giving a secure threaded connection for the hose.

products.name: Pillar Hydrant
products.short: Outdoor hydrant for firefighting water access.
products.desc: A two-way outdoor hydrant that gives firefighters direct access to the fire main. Each outlet has its own valve and cap, so two hose lines can be run at once.

products.name: Oblique Landing Valve
products.short: Hydrant valve for hose connection control.
products.desc: A hydrant valve with an angled outlet that connects hose to the building's fire main at each floor or landing. Available with flanged or screwed inlets.

products.name: Angle Hose Valve
products.short: Controls water discharge through fire hoses.
products.desc: A brass right-angle valve that controls water from the standpipe to the hose. Used inside hose cabinets and on hose racks.

products.name: Jacket Lay-flat Fire Hose
products.short: Flexible high-pressure firefighting water delivery hose.
products.desc: A woven-jacket fire hose with a rubber lining that lies flat when empty, so it rolls or folds compactly into cabinets and racks. Supplied with couplings fitted.
uses: Pillar hydrant and fire brigade use

products.name: Hydrant Box
products.short: Protective cabinet for hydrant equipment storage.
products.desc: A steel cabinet that keeps the landing valve, hose and nozzle together, protected and ready to use. Mounted on the wall or recessed beside the riser.

products.name: Fire Hose Reel
products.short: Quick-response hose reel for firefighting use.
products.desc: A swinging reel with semi-rigid hose that one person can run out and use immediately, without unrolling or connecting anything. Suited to first-response firefighting by building staff.

products.name: Breeching Inlet
products.short: Fire brigade water connection inlet point.
products.desc: The external connection where the fire service pumps water into the building's riser. Available as two-way and four-way inlets, each with caps and a drain valve.

products.name: Hose Rack
products.short: Organized storage rack for firefighting hoses.
products.desc: A wall-mounted rack that holds folded hose ready for use. When the hose is pulled, the rack releases it in a controlled way so it pays out without kinking.

products.name: Fog Nozzle
products.short: Produces fine mist for fire suppression.
products.desc: A brass nozzle that changes from a shut-off to a wide fog pattern by twisting the barrel. The fog pattern cools a fire and protects the operator.

products.name: ABC Dry Powder Extinguisher
products.short: Multipurpose extinguisher for Class A, B and C fires.
products.desc: The general-purpose extinguisher for solid materials, flammable liquids and gases. The most common choice for factories, warehouses and vehicles.

products.name: CO2 Extinguisher
products.short: Clean extinguisher for electrical and liquid fires.
products.desc: Discharges carbon dioxide gas that smothers a fire and leaves no residue, so it will not damage electrical equipment.

products.name: Wet Chemical Extinguisher
products.short: For cooking oil and fat fires.
products.desc: Designed for Class F fires in deep fat fryers and cooking oil. The chemical forms a soapy layer that cools the oil and seals the surface.

products.name: Foam Extinguisher
products.short: For solid materials and flammable liquid fires.
products.desc: Foam covers burning liquids to stop them re-igniting and also works on paper, wood and textiles. A good choice where flammable liquids are stored.

products.name: Water Spray Extinguisher
products.short: For Class A fires in solid materials.
products.desc: A water extinguisher with a spray nozzle for fires in paper, wood, fabric and other solid materials. Simple to use and low cost to refill.

products.name: Jockey Pump
products.short: Keeps the fire main pressurised.
products.desc: A small vertical multistage pump that makes up for minor leaks and keeps the system at its standby pressure, so the main fire pump only starts when there is real demand.
uses: Pressure maintenance in hydrant and sprinkler systems

products.name: Electric Fire Pump
products.short: Main fire pump driven by an electric motor.
products.desc: The main duty pump for hydrant and sprinkler systems, available as split-case or end-suction pumps with their motor, or as a skid-mounted set with controller and valves.

products.name: Diesel Fire Pump
products.short: Standby fire pump that runs without mains power.
products.desc: A diesel engine driven fire pump that keeps the system running during a power cut. Usually installed as the standby partner to an electric pump.

products.name: Pump Control Panel
products.short: Starts, stops and monitors the fire pumps.
products.desc: The controller that starts the fire pump automatically when system pressure drops and reports its status and alarms. Available for electric and diesel pumps.

products.name: Fire Pump Flow Meter
products.short: Measures pump flow for testing.
products.desc: Installed in the pump test line, the flow meter shows the pump's output so it can be tested regularly without discharging water through hydrants.
